title: Committed world presentation event page
description: A closed, read-only page in the independent authoritative world-presentation stream.
x-invariants: events are ordered by sequence, contain no duplicate event_id, and are gap-free.

For a non-empty page, from_sequence equals events[0].sequence, to_sequence equals the last event sequence, next_after_sequence equals to_sequence, and 1 <= from_sequence <= to_sequence <= presentation_high_watermark.
For an empty page, from_sequence, to_sequence, and next_after_sequence all equal the request after_sequence and has_more is false.
For a non-empty page, has_more is true if and only if to_sequence is less than presentation_high_watermark.
Every event world_id equals page world_id, stream_id equals 'world-presentation:' plus world_id, and tenant_id equals request_context.actor.tenant_id.

Every event final_snapshot_revision and final_world_event_sequence are less than or equal to page snapshot_revision and snapshot_last_event_sequence; historical events retain their own commit-final state hash.
Events with the same commit_id have identical commit identity, action_count, world_revision, and final snapshot binding; their action_index values increase by one and their state hashes chain.
At a commit boundary, the preceding event has action_index equal to action_count minus one and the next event starts at action_index zero; commit-final revision and world-event sequence increase.
Whenever an event has action_index equal to action_count minus one, its state_hash_after equals its final_snapshot_state_hash.

Only when a non-empty page reaches presentation_high_watermark, its last event must close its action set and its final_snapshot_revision, final_world_event_sequence, and final_snapshot_state_hash equal page snapshot_revision, snapshot_last_event_sequence, and snapshot_state_hash respectively.
Duplicate reads are side-effect-free; event_id and sequence are stable and consumers deduplicate by stream_id plus sequence plus event_id.
A consumer must reject the entire page and restore the authoritative snapshot when any schema, hash, identity, ordering, pagination, or final snapshot invariant is violated.
